semantic_disabled_reason: BruteForceEmbedding uses character n-gram hashing. With a shared 3000-char prefix, all prompts get similarity=1.0 regardless of suffix content. A real embedding model (e.g. text-embedding-3-small) would be needed for true semantic reuse. Semantic is disabled here to isolate memo and trie.
note: Simulates a realistic agent workflow: shared system prompt with varied suffixes, occasional repeated subtasks, occasional paraphrased queries, and queries outside the main topic domain. Memo and trie are enabled with priority order: memo > trie > backend.
